verdict.rationale: Llama is a model family with tooling and agent-oriented features, so a test or sandbox environment that is isolated from production data is a fair axis to ask about. However, no evidence documents any sandbox, test mode, or isolated environment offered by the product. Running weights locally or on partner clouds is a deployment option, not a product-provided sandbox, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
